summary: Governed dependency install behind an HITL batch gate: the dry-run lists the COMPLETE dependency set (with sources and target venv); one apply installs the whole batch. Never installs into the system interpreter.

packages.description: explicit package specs to add to the set

requirements.description: a requirements file (default: auto-detect requirements.txt + pyproject dependencies)

create_venv.description: create the venv if missing (required rather than using the system interpreter)

apply.description: install the whole batch (else preview the list)

packages.description: the full set: [{package, source}]  -  this is the ONE list to approve
